# Bell Legal Group

> South Carolina-based trial law firm specializing in personal injury, toxic exposure, and product liability claims with nationwide reach.

Bell Legal Group is a science-driven law firm led by J. Edward Bell III and Judge George C. Kosko, known as 'The Science Law Firm' for their evidence-based approach to complex litigation. The firm handles catastrophic injury cases, toxic tort claims, medical malpractice, and defective product lawsuits across South Carolina and nationally.

## Key Topics

- product liability

- AFFF/PFAS exposure
- defective products
